messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Aurora capacity handoff today 14:00 PST. Need final quota numbers, autoscale curve, and a confirmed loadtest window. TL;DR: goal is 800 rps sustained, 2k burst, mixed prompt profile (short prompts 65%, multi-step 35%).

oliver_se: Quick Q — which model variants are we serving? full-precision and quantized? Also what's the target concurrency per GPU?

nina_ts: Plan is v1 (fp16) for latency-critical routes and v1-q4 for costy batch. Target ~20 concurrent streams per A40 for v1-q4, ~12 for fp16. I'll run capacity calc and post numbers.

ben_eng: K6 snippet for smoke: ```k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m --rps 800 script.js``` ramp plan: 200 -> 800 over 5m, hold 10m, spike to 2k for 2m. Autoscale proposal: min=4 nodes, max=40 nodes, scale_step=2, cool_down=120s.

simon_re: CS asks for a failover/reroute plan if pool saturates — suggest policy: if queue_latency > 500ms OR queue_length > 50 then route 20% traffic to hosted fallback (model v1-fallback). Can we implement traffic-split rule?

maria_cs: Agree on 20% fallback. Also renewal wants a note: target P95 gen latency < 300ms for single-turn short prompts. If we risk regressions, flag the renewal owner.

tara_oncall: Oncall checklist: add alerts for queue_length > 50, gpu_util > 92% for 5m, gpu_mem_free < 6GB. Escalation: @tara_oncall -> @oliver_se -> oncall rotation. Rollback command: `/ops rollback-capacity aurora` (opsbot will run the playbook).

capacity-bot: Reminder: loadtest window scheduled for 2026-03-24T21:00Z UTC. Upload target: s3://redwood-loadtests/aurora/2026-03-24/. Please tag artifacts with `aurora-load-2026-03-24`.

ben_eng: One operational note: pre-warm KV cache with ~1M prefixes before the steady-phase ramp. Warmup script: `s3://warmups/aurora/prefix_warmup.py`. Also seed model weights cache by hitting the 3 heaviest endpoints once per worker.

nina_ts: I'll own warmup and smoke phases, will post timestamps. Plan: warmup start 20:45Z, steady ramp 21:00Z, spike at 21:20Z, teardown 21:35Z.

oliver_se: Quota ask: requesting 48 reserved GPUs initially (to meet sustained target + headroom). Autoscale covers burst. Maria, can CS confirm commitment to reserved counts for billing?

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Confirmed — 48 GPUs reserved initially. I'll attach signed PO after successful loadtest pass and SLA check. Also collecting customer feedback post-test; please ping product for any quality regressions.

simon_re: :party_parrot: Nice. Good luck everyone — ping here when the k6 results land.

maria_cs: Thanks — will update with the results and the PO. If anyone needs to join the runbook dry-run, speak now and we'll schedule a 30m preflight at 13:30 PST.
